request.description:
This is a GET request and it is used to "get" data from an endpoint. There is no request body for a GET request, but you can use query parameters to help specify the resource you want data on (e.g., in this request, we have `id=1`).

A successful GET response will have a `200 OK` status, and should include some kind of response body - for example, HTML web content or JSON data.

Retrieves a list of all books available in the catalog.

**Base URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/books`

## Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type   | Required | Description                                                                 |
|-----------|--------|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `type`    | string | No       | Filter books by type. Accepted values: `fiction`, `non-fiction`.            |
| `limit`   | number | No       | Limit the number of books returned. Must be a positive integer (max: 20).   |

## Response

Returns a JSON array of book objects. Each object contains:

| Field       | Type    | Description                              |
|-------------|---------|------------------------------------------|
| `id`        | number  | Unique identifier for the book.          |
| `name`      | string  | Title of the book.                       |
| `type`      | string  | Genre of the book (`fiction` or `non-fiction`). |
| `available` | boolean | Whether the book is available for order. |

## Example Response

```json
[
  { "id": 1, "name": "The Russian", "type": "fiction", "available": true },
  { "id": 2, "name": "Just as I Am", "type": "non-fiction", "available": false }
]
```

## Get Single Book

Retrieves detailed information about a specific book by its unique ID.

---

## Path Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bookId` | integer | ✅ Yes | The unique identifier of the book. |

---

## Sample Response — 200 OK

``` json
{
  "id": 1,
  "entityType": "BOOK",
  "available": true,
  "timestamp": 1752239490804,
  "created": "2025-07-11T13:11:30.804Z",
  "isbn": "1780899475",
  "name": "The Russian",
  "current-stock": 12,
  "price": 12.98,
  "author": "James Patterson and James O. Born",
  "type": "fiction"
}

 ```

---

## Response Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | integer | Unique identifier for the book. |
| `name` | string | Title of the book. |
| `author` | string | Name of the author(s). |
| `type` | string | Genre or category of the book (e.g. `fiction`, `non-fiction`). |
| `available` | boolean | Whether the book is currently available for order. |
| `price` | number | Price of the book in the default currency. |
| `current-stock` | integer | Number of copies currently in stock. |
| `isbn` | string | International Standard Book Number (ISBN) for the book. |
| `created` | string | ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the book record was created. |
